result.instructions: Tools for Taxmo, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What is my VAT position for quarter 2 of 2026?"; "Which invoices are overdue, and who are they for?"; "Log 3.5 hours on project 12 for today, billable, with the description 'Sprint review'.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Taxmo data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run taxmo_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run taxmo_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run taxmo_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. taxmo_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: taxmo_get_profile
tools.title: Get the business profile
tools.description: Get the business profile of the connected Taxmo account (name, KvK number, VAT number, address). Scope: read. GET /api/v1/profile. Good first call to confirm the connection.

tools.name: taxmo_list_entries
tools.title: List bookkeeping entries
tools.description: List bookkeeping entries (booked income and expense lines with their VAT category), optionally for one quarter and year. Scope: entries or read. GET /api/v1/entries.

tools.name: taxmo_get_vat_filing
tools.title: Get a VAT filing
tools.description: Get the VAT (BTW) filing for one quarter: the amounts per VAT grid row and the total to pay or to receive. Scope: reports or read. GET /api/v1/filings/{quarter}/{year}.

tools.name: taxmo_get_annual_summary
tools.title: Get an annual summary
tools.description: Get the annual summary for one year: revenue, expenses and VAT per quarter. Scope: reports or read. GET /api/v1/summary/{year}.

tools.name: taxmo_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List the invoices of the account (number, customer, date, total, status). Scope: invoices or read. GET /api/v1/invoices.

tools.name: taxmo_get_invoice
tools.title: Get an invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice with its lines, payments and payment status (draft, open, overdue, partially_paid or paid). Scope: invoices or read. Dutch accounts. GET /api/v1/invoices/{id}.

invoice_id.description: Taxmo numeric id, as a string.

tools.name: taxmo_get_invoice_by_external_id
tools.title: Get an invoice by your id
tools.description: Get one invoice by the externalId you set when you created it in your own system. Scope: invoices or read. Dutch accounts. GET /api/v1/invoices/external/{externalId}.

external_id.description: Your own id for the record (the externalId you set when creating it).

annotations.title: Get an invoice by your id

tools.name: taxmo_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List the customer and supplier contacts of the account. Scope: invoices or read. Dutch accounts. GET /api/v1/contacts.

tools.name: taxmo_get_contact
tools.title: Get a contact
tools.description: Get one contact by its Taxmo id. Scope: invoices or read. Dutch accounts. GET /api/v1/contacts/{id}.

contact_id.description: Taxmo numeric id, as a string.

tools.name: taxmo_get_contact_by_external_id
tools.title: Get a contact by your id
tools.description: Get one contact by the externalId you set when you created it in your own system. Scope: invoices or read. Dutch accounts. GET /api/v1/contacts/external/{externalId}.

external_id.description: Your own id for the record (the externalId you set when creating it).

annotations.title: Get a contact by your id

tools.name: taxmo_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List the time-tracking projects. Use the id of a project as projectId in taxmo_add_time_entry. Scope: write (the docs list write for this GET; read may also work). GET /api/v1/projects.

tools.name: taxmo_add_time_entry
tools.title: Add a time entry
tools.description: Add one time entry to a project. This creates a new record each call (no duplicate check): call it once per entry. Scope: write. POST /api/v1/time-entries.

description.description: What the time was spent on.

hourly_rate.description: Hourly rate in EUR, excl. VAT.

billable.description: true when the time is billed to the client.

tools.name: taxmo_log_hours
tools.title: Log hours (urencriterium)
tools.description: Add hours to the urencriterium hours log (Netherlands only). This creates a new record each call (no duplicate check): call it once per entry. Scope: write. POST /api/v1/hours-log.

project_name.description: Project name shown in the log.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Taxmo
prompts.description: What you can do with Taxmo here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: check_the_vat_position_for_a_quarter
prompts.title: Check the VAT position for a quarter
prompts.description: Get the VAT filing for one quarter, with the amounts per VAT grid row and the total to pay or to receive. Read the business profile too.

prompts.name: review_the_annual_summary
prompts.title: Review the annual summary
prompts.description: Get revenue, expenses and VAT per quarter for one year. List the bookkeeping entries for the same period.

prompts.name: find_overdue_invoices
prompts.title: Find overdue invoices
prompts.description: List the invoices, then open one to see its lines and payment status, such as overdue. List the customer and supplier contacts too.

prompts.name: look_up_invoices_and_contacts_by_your_own_id
prompts.title: Look up invoices and contacts by your own id
prompts.description: Get one invoice or one contact by the externalId you set in your own system.

prompts.name: log_time_or_hours
prompts.title: Log time or hours
prompts.description: Add a time entry to a project, or add hours to the urencriterium log in the Netherlands. Each call adds a new record, so call once per entry.
